520134.name: Heavy Particle Cannon
520134.description: Fires a heavy particle cannon, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

520135.name: Fang Missile
520135.description: Fires missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

520136.name: Giant Magnetic Field Barrier
520136.description: Generates a Barrier around the Land Eater to defend against attacks.

520137.name: Homing Laser
520137.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke. Does not trigger Cancel Rings while the Giant Magnetic Field Barrier is active.

520138.name: Saturation Attack
520138.description: Launches an all-out assault, dealing damage to a single Nikke. Does not trigger Cancel Rings while the Giant Magnetic Field Barrier is active.

520143.name: Saturation Attack II
